profile.summary: eternityduck demonstrates a mid-level JavaScript proficiency with contributions focused on the Axios library, primarily in backend Node.js environments. Their work shows strong awareness of performance optimization and functional programming influences, particularly through contributions to the `findKey` utility function. While contributions are currently limited to Axios, the developer exhibits a solid understanding of modern JavaScript object handling and defensive programming practices. There is no direct evidence of frontend framework expertise or TypeScript usage, but their contributions indicate a backend-leaning JavaScript developer with a focus on efficient, production-grade code.
